title: Custom Agent state not sharing between supervisor and agents after 0.0.12 release
body:
I have a custom state that is shared between the supervisor and its agents:
```
class State(AgentState):
    context_id: str
```

I update the `context_id` on the supervisor init, but the `context_id` is not visible in the agent state before running a tool. This worked in version 0.0.11.
author: mikkkeldp

comments.body: @mikkkeldp the issue should be fixed in 0.0.13 - thanks for reporting!

satisfaction_conditions: A fix for the state sharing issue between supervisor and agents in version 0.0.12
Timely resolution of the reported regression bug
